name: Dash World [PLATFORMER]
desc:
Dash World

This game is inspired by geometry dash; made by robtopgames, featuring everything, vibrant colors, colorful effects and more!

Features: 
➤ Colorful, Vibrant, Shiny and Fun environments.
➤ Make your own levels with the editor tools or play community made levels to test your skills!

Supported Platforms: PC, Mobile & Console

Credits to: Talented Musical Artists, RobTopGames, @Dubairusi for the Trailer & various image assets
